baseWorkroomRef.description: Reference to the base Workroom container that this ProfessionalWorkroom profiles.

policyDecisionRefs.description: Policy or guardrail decision refs explicitly admitting, denying, quarantining, or requiring review for workroom operations.

topicPackRefs.description: Slash-topic topic-pack or membrane refs scoping search, knowledge, policy posture, source admission, and display behavior.

memoryScopeRefs.description: Refs describing governed memory/retrieval scope, representation strata, recall bounds, and writeback boundaries.

privacyDecisionRefs.description: DoNotLearn / DoNotLink privacy decision refs for learning, linking, memory, transcript, topic, or graph operations.

audioReviewRefs.description: Speechlab audio review refs for audio events, transcript artifacts, review sections, corrections, and audio review receipts.

learningReceiptRefs.description: Systems-learning-loops or model-governance-ledger receipts recording lessons, memory decisions, teaching-object promotion, or adoption feedback.

officeArtifactRefs.description: Workspace-bound office artifacts such as documents, spreadsheets, slide decks, PDFs, mail drafts, calendar items, task lists, notes, and media assets.

contextGraphRefs.description: Workspace Context Fabric graph refs bound to this workroom.

captureCadence.description: Governed capture cadence for this objective — the sprint the agentic operating system runs it through. Composes over the canonical sourceos-spec CaptureCadence + ReadinessScore rather than duplicating them; tracks the current position and readiness gate.

cadenceRef.description: urn:srcos:capture-cadence:… — the canonical cadence definition (weeks, min-readiness gates, exit decisions).

minReadiness.description: Minimum readiness required to exit the current week's gate.

nextReviewAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the next cadence review.

readinessScoreRef.description: urn:srcos:readiness-score:… — the current readiness scorecard for this objective.

officeArtifactRef.description: Optional OfficeArtifact associated with this task.
